sloka: वत्स राम चिरं जीव हतास्ते परिपन्थिनः ।ज्ञातीन्मे त्वं श्रियायुक्तः सुमित्रायाश्च नन्दय ॥२-४-३९॥
transliteration: vatsa rāma ciraṁ jīva hatāste paripanthinaḥ ।jñātīnme tvaṁ śriyāyuktaḥ sumitrāyāśca nandaya ॥2-4-39॥

translations.english: "Surely my endurance in this lotus-eyed man was not in vain, my son, since this very royal fortune of the Ikshvakus shall now attend upon you."
